0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The Tholl gourmand is licking his lips at some idle thought.

25.original: Entice the juvenile cliffmole into the empty larder sack using a wriggling grub.

26.original: Deliver the full larder sack to the Tholl gourmand.

49.original: ...I mean, lali-ho! Almost forgot my manners there! Bad etiquette, that. Why don't I make up for it by cooking us a tasty steak <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF0764696E6E6572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF0764696E6E65720303>, eh? I'm thinking a nice cut of cliffmole...

50.original: Aye, well, I suppose that sounds none too appetizing. And the meat of an adult cliffmole <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> about as pleasant as chewing on your grandma's second-favorite pair of boots.

51.original: A friend of mine, though, he reckons the younger moles are tender and juicy as they come! What say you? Shall we put that claim to the test?

52.original: Then we'll need to catch one first. The juveniles are said to stay near humid areas, like caves and streams. I'm more of a “cave” kind of dwarf, so you can search the waterways.

53.original: Oh, and they're apparently a skittish lot─you'll need a plump grub to lure one in before you can stuff it in a sack!

54.original: Right. There's your grub, and there's your sack. Meet me back here and we'll set the pan to sizzling!

56.original: The juvenile cliffmole eyes you warily. Time to show it the wriggling grub, then lure it into the sack...

59.original: The cliffmole trundles happily into the sack and begins feasting on the grub...

60.original: Couldn't find me any of the small ones. What about you?

61.original: Would you look at that! And on your first try, too! I'll just get a fire going and─

63.original: Th-Those big, round eyes... That lovable face! How could anyone eat such a precious dumpling!

64.original: ...I can't do it! Not even for the best steak in the world! Have this coin for your trouble, but <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF0764696E6E6572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF0764696E6E65720303>'s canceled!

65.original: From this day forward, I'll raise you as my own! I'll feed you, and pet you, and call you “Cliffy”!
